reports._country_note: Refiled AR/AE → INT on 2026-08-18. `validate()` flags an international- or supranational-level publisher carrying a country code, and the publisher here is the IMF, which belongs to no single country — the definition `Country` gives for INT. This is a rim-colour and family change only; nothing else reads the field.

dependencies.basis: Article 4 of Ley 23.548 sets each province's fixed share of the coparticipable mass by name and percentage (Buenos Aires 19.93%, and so on for every adhering province, including Córdoba) — a province's federal-transfer fiscal capacity is mechanically set by this law, not by anything the province itself does.
Same Article 4 mechanism as ar-cordoba-entity — Santa Fe's fixed coparticipation percentage is set by name in the law.

Same Article 4 mechanism — Chaco's fixed coparticipation percentage is set by name in the law. Directly relevant to the batch-4 homogeneity test: Chaco's high poverty sits alongside a fiscal capacity that is largely determined by this formula rather than by local revenue.
Same Article 4 mechanism — Formosa's fixed coparticipation percentage is set by name in the law.
Article 3 fixes the Nación's automatic share of the coparticipable mass at 42.34%, which is the core split the general-government revenue accounts are built on.

Net international reserves accumulation is a tracked performance criterion under the EFF program — multiple 2026 reports describe Argentina as 'cerca de alcanzar el objetivo de reservas netas para fines de 2026' (close to meeting the FMI's net-reserves target for end-2026) and, later, as having met it for the first time.
AFIP/ARCA's monthly tax collection is the primary revenue-side input to the general-government sector accounts.

INDEC's balance-of-payments release is titled and published jointly as 'Balanza de pagos, posición de inversión internacional y deuda externa' — external debt is reported inside the same statistical operation as the BOP/IIP, not as a separate unrelated series.
Household income used for the poverty/indigency calculation includes non-labour transfer income, which is where AUH would be captured, per the general EPH income-distribution methodology.
